FN-UYIJGDD-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 59
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 59 as reported by the Committee on Healthcare would require each local board of
education, beginning in the 2024-2025 school year, to include instruction in the use of
automated external defibrillators (AEDs) within existing health education courses. The
provisions of this bill could increase the obligations of the Alabama State Board of Education by
an undetermined amount to adopt rules implementing the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
